description: This PHP file defines classes and functions for database backup and dump operations, including creating SQL dumps, saving database structures, and zipping files for download within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: DatabaseDump
classes.description: Class for creating SQL database dumps, including table structures and data, and saving to a file.

classes.name: createZip
classes.description: Class for creating ZIP archives, adding files and directories, and forcing download of the archive.

classes.name: createDirZip
classes.description: Subclass of createZip for adding entire directories and their contents to a ZIP archive.

methods.name: save_structure
methods.description: Function to save the database structure and data into a dump file.

methods.name: DatabaseDump
methods.description: Constructor for DatabaseDump class, establishing database connection.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Method to generate and save SQL dump of a specified database.

methods.name: writeln
methods.description: Write string with newline to file.

methods.name: addDirectory
methods.description: Add a directory to ZIP archive.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Add a file with data to ZIP archive.

methods.name: getZippedfile
methods.description: Retrieve the complete ZIP archive as a string.

methods.name: forceDownload
methods.description: Force download of the ZIP archive as a file.

methods.name: get_files_from_folder
methods.description: Recursively add files and subdirectories from a folder into ZIP archive.
